home.title: Protect before you invest.
home.description: RakshakAI helps you understand suspicious financial messages, screenshots and links before pressure turns into a costly decision.
analysis.title: Understand before you act.
analysis.intro: Share the content that raised a question. We’ll surface risk indicators and give you practical verification steps.
analysis.messageHint: WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS or email text
analysis.urlHint: Review URL structure without opening the destination
analysis.imageHint: PNG, JPG or WEBP up to 5 MB
analysis.documentHint: PDF or image up to 10 MB
analysis.placeholder: Paste the message here. Never include OTPs, passwords or PINs.
analysis.drop: Drop a file here or browse
analysis.info: This is an informational check. It cannot confirm fraud or tell you what to invest in.
analysis.confidenceNote: Confidence describes the signals detected in the submitted content, not whether it is legally fraudulent.
analysis.noPatterns: No configured patterns detected. That does not establish safety.
analysis.verifyNote: Keep control of the next step. Do not let a message set your pace.
analysis.riskNote: A risk level is a prompt to verify, not a legal determination.
analysis.signInSave: Sign in to keep your history private.
analysis.savedOnly: Your analysis is saved only to your account.
analysis.signInAnalyze: Sign in to save and review a private analysis.
analysis.failed: We could not complete that analysis.
analysis.voiceUnsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser.
analysis.voiceError: We could not hear that. Try again or paste the text.
risk.label: RISK INDICATORS
home.step1Text: Paste a message, upload a screenshot or enter a link you want to understand.
home.step2Text: RakshakAI highlights patterns and quotes the evidence it found in simple language.
home.step3Text: Use a practical checklist before replying, paying or sharing personal information.
home.privacyHeading: Your safety comes first. Your secrets stay yours.
home.privacyBody: No OTPs. No passwords. No bank details. In demo mode, uploaded bytes are validated and discarded, and URL checks never contact the destination.
home.cta: A safer pause can change the outcome.
home.featureMessageText: Spot urgency, impersonation, payment requests and other social engineering patterns.
home.featureImageText: Extract context from a screenshot without sending private chats to anyone.
home.featureLinkText: Review a URL’s structure locally before you open it or share details.
home.featurePlainText: Turn complex financial wording into questions you can verify yourself.
analysis.problemNone: No configured warning pattern matched. That does not prove the message or link is safe.
